notes: Flat layout: every tool's files sit together in this one folder — the bundle adds no per-tool folders of its own. A tool keeps only the structure its own portable edition ships with (Charon's Charon folder and NitroCore's _internal folder are part of those tools).

One file-name collision, resolved openly: all four portable editions carry a file named README-PORTABLE.txt, each with different contents. In this bundle each is kept as README-PORTABLE-<Tool>.txt — contents unchanged; only the name is qualified, so nothing overwrites anything.

Argus portable mode: starting Argus from the launcher (or from Argus-Portable.bat) keeps its settings, scan history, and quarantine vault in the ArgusData folder inside this folder, so they travel with the bundle.
